answer.title: Denver Kiln Doctor Pricing
answer.text:
Denver Kiln Doctor Pricing

Service call fees
Diagnostic visit (within Denver city limits): $85. Covers arrival, inspection of elements, relays, and controller, and a written estimate.
Diagnostic visit (outside city limits, up to 25 miles): $120.
The diagnostic fee is waived when repair work is approved during the same visit.

Parts and labor
Parts are billed at cost plus 15%. Labor is billed at $78 per hour, billed in half-hour increments after the first hour.

Emergency and weekend visits
Same-day emergency visits are quoted by phone at (303) 555-0147. Weekend visits carry a $40 surcharge.

Payment
We accept card, check, and ACH. A 50% deposit is required before parts are ordered.

answer.title: Kiln Repair Denver - Front Range Furnace & Kiln
answer.text:
Kiln Repair Denver

Front Range Furnace & Kiln repairs kilns for pottery studios, schools, and art programs across the Denver metro area.

Services
Element replacement
Controller and relay diagnostics
Firing system tune-ups
Emergency same-day visits (before 12 pm, subject to availability)

Service calls
A base visit fee of $110 covers diagnostic inspection and up to 30 minutes on site. The visit fee is waived if approved repair work is completed during the same visit. Parts are billed at cost plus 15%. Labor is $85 per hour after the first 30 minutes, billed in 15-minute increments.

Hours: Monday through Friday, 8 am to 5 pm.

To schedule a visit, call the office or request a service call online.

Pricing

Service calls
Standard service call fee: $95 within Denver city limits. Covers the on-site diagnostic visit. The fee is credited toward the repair if you approve the work on the same visit.

Parts and labor
Parts are billed at cost plus 15%. Labor is billed at $85 per hour after the first hour, which is included in the service call fee.

Office hours: Monday through Friday, 8 am to 5 pm. Saturday 9 am to 1 pm.
